name: wachiman

wachimanDataCollection.1.22.0: Opt-in usage metrics: after a yes in `wachiman init` or `wachiman telemetry on`, each local review or ask sends one small summary (counts and categories, a random installation ID, never code, paths, repository names or account identifiers). Off by default; DO_NOT_TRACK, WACHIMAN_TELEMETRY=0, CI and GITHUB_ACTIONS stop it. See docs/on-your-machine.md#telemetry

description: Advisory pull request reviews by an agent CLI, run in your own GitHub Actions with your own key, or locally on your own Claude subscription
